other_conditions: Must be registered under the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board
Eligibility for assistance begins only after three months from registration
Must have an active membership of the Board
Worker must have worked at least 90 days during the preceding one year
Child must be enrolled in any grade from Class I up to higher education or professional courses
Benefits are provided only for the first two children of the registered worker
benefits_summary: Provides yearly financial assistance for education of the first two children of registered construction workers, ranging from ₹1,800 to ₹10,000 depending on the child's class/course.
